# Set81 retained original-job admission actual helper

This separate source tree is prepared for root-owned builds and actual execution. No actual result is claimed by source authoring. It uses the published fixture wallet/authority inputs and original production operator, headless miner, TLS clients, pool source, issuer, schema14 account and schema16 payout wallet. It never reads a live private store for evidence. Closed original full audits precede each bounded public raw-row projection.

The parent plan62ddde39 and pre-execution cadence successor define two cases. Both require exactly two canonical pool rewards at the selected real block target; the target is the fighter proof corresponding to accepted sequence2. The relay observes actual issued work and pool submit/lookup replies, validates each target, and retains the same captures across operator generations. It never manually submits a proof or creates a response. Its only fault is an explicitly bounded preforward hold and, for A, loss of one genuine inserted admission reply before headers. Initial hold is canceled by joining the CLI, then no HTTP request is held while original operator stdout establishes pool-only drain/readiness.

A reopens the same owners for live admission, loses that genuine success, closes/audits the committed original record and pending local row, then reopens for exact historical replay. B keeps the initial target unforwarded, stops all worker/operator lifetimes, generates the100 normal descendants to104 during that stopped interval, waits the remaining real original expiry, then obtains authenticated definite expired and proves the target has no record/ownership evidence. Both reopen the original controller stopped, mature the two original coinbases, use the actual initial UTC due and original schema16 signer, confirm the one whole payout, and prove the exact wallet increase plus stopped outbox invariance. No Set80 issuance-gap/SIGKILL scenario is repeated.

The independent17557b28 selection changes only an existing-supported maintenance interval to1000 and its dependent IDs. Limits, target, source and money semantics remain exact. Two-reward economics are fixed at miner1,980,000,000, fee209, change19,999,791. Due is still initial start+7minutes, minute-truncated; scenario900s/outer1080s and chain180 limits remain. The actual operator status cadence stays30s. The 90s read-only readiness wait has no held request; every target hold remains at most10s and cannot outlive its original job expiry. A missed live/due window fails this attempt rather than selecting replacement work or changing the schedule.

`source-manifest.json` lists flat build files and every selected source/document/input identity. `reuse-manifest.json` and `inheritance.diff` identify all reused original bytes and the four adapted leaves (main, selection, module path, and CLI status enum permitting the actual `expired` result). New Go leaves are the admission relay, scenario flow and service-authored closed admission audit. Original Set80 sources/checkers remain untouched; no old failure directories are copied. The inherited RPC relay stays unarmed and only observes the actual signed payout. The existing process owners retain single Wait/Close/TERM handling; there are zero intentional crashes.

`PUBLIC_SCHEMA.md` is the exact evidence index for the separately authored checker. All global unrelated births/ownership rows and finite q consumption are retained/reported. Per-target request/job/proof/authorization/result stays immutable. No new issued job/work may appear after the first full-source audit. Terminal q consumption after reconciliation remains a finite-capacity limitation; this proof does not establish indefinite readiness, public hosting, migration or new economic policy.

Source-only checks comprise literal identity/preimage comparisons and finite independent peer reads. Only root may format/build/run, freeze the final execution lock, validate normal production PoW, execute both cases and assess the independent checker result. No helper test clock or signing callback is introduced.
